spec.body_markdown: ## Making a Graph That Speaks for Itself\n\nGive it a clear title, label both axes with units, use the full scale instead of crowding points in a corner, plot each point precisely, and connect them with a line once you trust the trend. Scatter plots suit noisy data, line graphs suit confirmed trends, and bar graphs suit comparing categories.
